capabilities.why: The workflow's entire browser surface runs through the sandbox browser runtime: the browser-agent template's own Chromium renders every page, screenshot, and the poisoned review inside the guest. When the platform serves its CDP gateway the host Playwright attaches to it; otherwise the guest's preinstalled Playwright drives the same Chromium over the audited exec path. Mock runs replay the same validated action schema through a host Playwright stand-in.

Every shell command the agent requests passes a deny-by-default allowlist policy in the control-plane adapter before any SDK dispatch; the prompt-injection command extracted from the customer review is blocked there and still audited. The Celesto Cloud SDK exposes no command callbacks, so the hook layer is enforced at this boundary instead of inside the guest.
